question: What destructive power over the triple world arises when the adept becomes angry?
premises: Anger activates a formidable power in the adept.
The scope of this power extends to the entire triple world.
The triple world includes both moving and unmoving beings.
inference: When angry, the adept can destroy the entire triple world with all its moving and unmoving beings.
plain_english: When angry, he can destroy the entire triple world, with all that moves and does not move.
